metadata.description: Rafal's Claude Code plugins: Mermaid diagram authoring and SSO-gated browser testing.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Author Mermaid diagrams that render correctly the first time and read clearly. Verified per-type templates (flowchart, sequence, state, class, ER, gantt), readability and layout rules, dark-background contrast fix, and a render-and-verify loop.

plugins.name: browser-test
plugins.description: Browser-test a deployed web app behind an SSO login wall (Cloudflare Access, Google SSO, Okta) by reusing your logged-in Chrome session over raw CDP. Zero-dependency driver, VERIFY/CHECK QA loop, hard assertions, report template.
